name: third-party.github-mcp
description: Curated provider manifest for the repo.remote, ci.status and repo.security capabilities.

repo.remote.fallback: Use local git, gh CLI with explicit commands, or the GitHub web UI manually.

ci.status.fallback: Use the GitHub web UI, gh run/list commands, or provider-native CI status surfaces manually.

repo.security.fallback: Use GitHub security tabs, Dependabot/secret scanning UI, or explicit gh/API commands manually.

install.method: Configure the upstream GitHub MCP server with minimal toolsets for the target agent.
uninstall: Remove the GitHub MCP server from the target agent MCP configuration and revoke unused GitHub tokens.

network: github.com repositories allowed by the configured token
permissions.approval: Human approval required for write operations, workflow actions, security changes or token-scope changes.

transport.notes: Local MCP server using a GitHub token; default to read-only/review flows.

security.notes: Never default to the GitHub MCP `all` toolset. Use minimal token scopes and require approval for sensitive operations.

risk.notes: GitHub tokens can expose private repositories and mutate issues, PRs, CI or security settings.
